The central figure is a male musician with long blonde hair playing a violin, wearing a black t-shirt and shorts. To his left is another musician in a hat playing guitar/bass, and to the right, a keyboardist or drummer is partially visible. The background consists of large black speaker stacks and stage rigging. The foreground shows stage monitors and equipment cases.
